hook: Your Netflix screenshot comes out as a black screen.
title: Your Netflix Screenshot Is Just Black
description:
Try taking a screenshot while a Netflix or Prime Video show is playing. On many phones the picture comes out as a plain black frame. The apps block screen capture to protect the video.

#Shorts #Netflix #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Did yours go black? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your Netflix screenshot comes out as a black screen.
scenes.headline: SCREENSHOT = BLACK

scenes.narration: Open any show and play it.
scenes.headline: PLAY ANY SHOW

scenes.narration: Now take a screenshot, like always.
scenes.headline: TAKE A SCREENSHOT

scenes.narration: Open your gallery. The picture is just black.
scenes.headline: ONLY BLACK

scenes.narration: The app told your phone to block the capture.
scenes.headline: APP BLOCKS IT

scenes.narration: It is meant to protect the movies.
scenes.headline: PROTECTING MOVIES

scenes.narration: Same trick works on Prime Video, on many phones.
scenes.headline: TRY PRIME TOO

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: the country that is almost underwater.
scenes.headline: NEXT: LOWEST COUNTRY
